site.name: Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow)
site.source: NASA NSSDC / LROC coordinates of the Apollo 17 LM
site.note: Equatorial reference site: contrast with the polar cases.

data.ephemeris_corrections: apparent: light-time + stellar aberration; AIRLESS (no refraction)
notes: Terrain horizon NOT computed: no DEM covers this site. theta = 0 for every azimuth.

limits: 'Viable' is geometry only: sunlight and line of sight. No thermal, antenna or detailed power model.
Time step of 1 h: events are resolved to +/- 30 min.
Horizon from the DEM's finite resolution; an unresolved boulder can hide the Sun.
Without a DEM covering the site the horizon is flat (theta = 0) and the result is optimistic; the trace says so.
Limb darkening of the Sun ignored (uniform disc).

metres.note: Flat horizon: mast height cannot change the result. Needs a DEM.

km.note: Flat horizon: every grid point is identical. Needs a DEM.

result.value: Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow) | start 2027-01-15T00:00:00+00:00 | 14 d | mast 2.0 m | autonomy 40.0 h | max gap 48.0 h | step 1.0 h

steps.name: Sun and Earth topocentric positions (JPL Horizons)
steps.description: Azimuth, elevation and range of the Sun and the Earth as seen from the site, hour by hour.
assumptions: apparent: light-time + stellar aberration; AIRLESS (no refraction)
Lunar orientation (libration) from the DE ephemeris used by Horizons
Site altitude as given; Horizons geodetic coordinates on the lunar reference sphere
steps.uncertainty: Horizons positional accuracy far exceeds the 1-hour grid; interpolation between epochs is linear

steps.name: Terrain horizon — MISSING DATA (flat horizon assumed)
assumptions: No LOLA DEM available for this site: horizon taken as the local horizontal plane
Results that depend on terrain (sunlight %, Earth visibility, night length) are optimistic
steps.uncertainty: Unbounded: real terrain near the poles can raise the horizon by several degrees

inputs.name: R_b
inputs.source: IAU 2015 Resolution B3 nominal solar radius

steps.name: Visible fraction of the sun's disc (numerical)
assumptions: Uniform disc: limb darkening ignored
Tangent-plane geometry over the disc (rho < 0.3 deg)
Horizon linearly interpolated between azimuth samples
steps.uncertainty: Equal-area sampling: fraction resolved to ~2.2e-04; max |numerical - segment formula| over the grid = 0.0011

steps.name: Analytic check: circular segment (sun)
steps.description: Closed-form check of the numerical integration.
assumptions: Horizon treated as straight at theta(A) across the disc

inputs.name: R_b
inputs.source: IAU/IERS mean Earth radius (volumetric); used for angular size only

steps.name: Visible fraction of the earth's disc (numerical)
assumptions: Uniform disc: limb darkening ignored
Tangent-plane geometry over the disc (rho < 0.3 deg)
Horizon linearly interpolated between azimuth samples
steps.uncertainty: Equal-area sampling: fraction resolved to ~2.2e-04; max |numerical - segment formula| over the grid = 0.0000

steps.name: Analytic check: circular segment (earth)
steps.description: Closed-form check of the numerical integration.
assumptions: Horizon treated as straight at theta(A) across the disc

steps.name: Solar irradiance at the Moon

inputs.name: S_0
inputs.source: Total solar irradiance at 1 AU, Kopp & Lean (2011) GRL 38, L01706

steps.uncertainty: S_0 varies ~0.1% over the solar cycle (not modelled)

steps.name: Panel electrical power
steps.formula: P = S \cdot A \cdot \eta \cdot \cos i \cdot f,\quad i = 0\ (\text{tracking})
assumptions: Panel efficiency constant (temperature and degradation ignored)
Irradiance taken over the visible fraction of the disc with no limb darkening

steps.name: Hourly energy balance and state of charge
assumptions: Constant load; charge/discharge efficiency 100%; no thermal model

steps.name: Share of mission time with sunlight
assumptions: 'Sunlight' = any part of the solar disc above the terrain horizon

steps.name: Share of mission time with the Earth visible
Time to the next sunset / sunrise
Survival verdict
steps.formula: \text{survives} \iff T_{night} \le T_{aut} \wedge T_{gap} \le T_{gap,max};\ \text{marginal if } \max(T_{night}/T_{aut}, T_{gap}/T_{gap,max}) \ge 1 - 0.1
assumptions: Verdict compares two numbers; it does not simulate the battery (see energy balance)

steps.name: Margin in days (delay tolerance)
steps.formula: M_d = \max\{d : \forall d' \le d,\ T_{night}(d') \le T_{aut} \wedge T_{gap}(d') \le T_{gap,max}\}
assumptions: Delay scanned in whole days; the mission window keeps its duration

steps.name: Margin in metres (mast height)
steps.formula: \%_{sun}(h) \text{ with } r_o = R + z_s + h \text{ in the horizon formula}

inputs.name: h
inputs.source: Engine parameter: minimum mast height scanned

assumptions: Flat horizon: mast height cannot change the result. Needs a DEM.

steps.name: Margin in kilometres (5 x 5 neighbourhood)
steps.formula: \text{viable}(\Delta n, \Delta e) \text{ with the horizon recomputed at each point}

inputs.name: grid
inputs.source: Engine parameter: grid side (5 x 5 points)

assumptions: Flat horizon: every grid point is identical. Needs a DEM.
